Name: lunakatt's DCBurger style portraits for Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks
Author: lunakatt
Description:
[size=4]lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks![/size]

[size=4][size=3]This is a mod in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's High Res Portrait Mod[/url], for the NPCs of LemurKat's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks[/url]!


[u][size=4][b]Content Patcher Version:[/b][/size][/u]
[/size][/size][size=3]Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=4][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks[/url][/size][/size]
[size=4][size=3]
Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed
2. Extract the CP version of this mod into your mods directory
3. Run the game using SMAPI

[size=4][u][b]Replacement Version:[/b][/u][/size]
Required mods: [/size][/size]
[size=4][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url][/size][/size][/size]
[size=4][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks[/url][/size][/size]
[size=4][size=3]
[size=4][size=3]Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed[/size][/size]
2. Find where Juliet & Jessie is installed in your mods folder
3. Drag the downladed folder called "[b][NPC] Juliet & Jessie[/b]" into "[b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[NPC] Juliet & Jessie[/b]" and let it overwrite when prompted
[size=4][size=3]3. Run the game using SMAPI[/size][/size]



[size=2][size=3]Thank you as always to DCBurger!
Thank you to LemurKat for her gorgeous characters and her endless patience TuT
[/size][/size][/size][/size][size=4][size=3][size=2][size=3]Psst, go check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120691188]OrangePie[/url]'s portrait mods!

Check out my Stardew Valley Expanded portraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9029]here[/url]![/size][/size][/size][/size][size=3]

[/size]
